headline: US lawmakers propose banning DUV chipmaking tool exports to leading Chinese firms, escalating tech trade war.
summary: A bipartisan proposal to restrict DUV lithography and etching tool exports to companies like Huawei and SMIC marks a major tightening of US tech controls. This move directly impacts China's domestic semiconductor production capabilities, further straining global supply chains and intensifying the US-China competition for AI and advanced technology dominance.
